definitions.gloss: honorarium; monetary reward; remuneration for services
definitions.explanation: A payment given as thanks for a service rendered, such as a lecture, consultation, or other professional contribution. Distinct from a regular salary or fee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{講演|こうえん}→講演：02735_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{謝金|しゃきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: To receive an honorarium for a lecture.

examples.japanese: {謝金|しゃきん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{三万円|さんまんえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{支払|しはら}われた→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: Thirty thousand yen was paid as an honorarium.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}して→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧⟦くださった→くださる：01305_kudasaru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{謝金|しゃきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{支払|しはら}い→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We will pay an honorarium to those who cooperated with the research.

notes:
Composed of {謝|しゃ} (thanks, gratitude) and {金|きん} (money). A formal term for a monetary payment given as thanks for professional services, typically one-time contributions rather than ongoing employment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {謝金|しゃきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧: to pay an honorarium
- {謝金|しゃきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive an honorarium
- ⟦{講演|こうえん}→講演：02735_kouen⟧{謝金|しゃきん}: lecture honorarium
- ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧{謝金|しゃきん}: research cooperation honorarium

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{報酬|ほうしゅう}→報酬：12094_houshuu⟧: remuneration / reward — broader term for compensation, can be larger amounts
- ⟦{謝礼|しゃれい}→謝礼：16034_sharei⟧: token of gratitude — can be money or a gift, slightly less formal
- ⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧: allowance / stipend — regular additional payment for specific duties

REGISTER:
Formal. Commonly used in academic, government, and business contexts, particularly on official forms and budget documents.
